title: Samāpatti-kallita
text: 1-3 Sāvatthi || || Cattāro me bhikkhave jhāyī || || Katame cattāro || || 4 Idha bhikkhave ekacco jhāyī samādhismiṃ samāpattikusalo hoti na samādhismim kallitakusalo || || 5 Idha pana bhikkhave ekacco jhāyī samādhismim kallitakusalo hoti na samādhismiṃ samāpattikusalo || || 6 Idha pana bhikkhave ekacco jhāyī neva samādhismiṃ samāpattikusalo hoti na samādhismiṃ kallilakusalo || || 7 Idha pana bhikkhave ekacco jhāyī samādhismiṃ samāpattikusalo ca hoti samādhismiṃ kallitakusalo ca || || 8-9 Tatra || pa || pavaro cāti || ||
